title: Proteomic profiling of the local and systemic immune response to pediatric respiratory viral infections.
summary: Proteomic profiling identifies local and systemic immune-response patterns in critically ill children with viral lower-respiratory infection and develops a diagnostic signature.
ai_technology: Mass-spectrometry/antibody proteomic measurements from tracheal aspirate and blood are compared across pediatric cohorts; machine learning builds a parsimonious classifier.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: Proteomic profiling identifies local and systemic immune-response patterns in critically ill children with viral lower-respiratory infection and develops a diagnostic signature.
evidence.unknown: The signature is limited to the sampled critically ill children and infection types; independent prospective diagnostic performance was not established.
evidence.ai_role: Mass-spectrometry/antibody proteomic measurements from tracheal aspirate and blood are compared across pediatric cohorts; machine learning builds a parsimonious classifier.
